How the library works

1

Convert

Pick a source scale and target scale in the stlscale engine. Get the slicer percentage.

2

Save

Click "Save to Library." The conversion stores in your browser's localStorage. No account, no password, no server.

3

Reuse

Come back anytime. Your saved conversions are here. Copy the percentage, open the details page, or delete what you no longer need.

Your data stays on your device

The library uses localStorage, which means your conversion history lives in your browser, not on my server. Clear your browser data and the library clears too. I cannot see what you save. I do not want to. This is a tool, not a data collection operation.
